review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped Mathlib for other uses and similar definitions: GameAdd appears only here, in Logic/Hydra, in Data/DFinsupp/WellFounded and in SetTheory/ZFC/Ordinal, and those files use it rather than redefine it. I also compared the other candidate concepts. Prod.Lex and Prod.RProd are different relations, and the file relates GameAdd to them with gameAdd_le_lex and rprod_le_transGen_gameAdd. Sym2.GameAdd is built on Sym2.lift₂ and Prod.GameAdd, so it is not a competing structure. The recursion definitions are thin named wrappers around WellFounded.fix, which the rubric treats as legitimate API. I found no independent Mathlib, Batteries or core definition of the same relation that this file duplicates. The evidence is not exhaustive: I did not search Batteries or core in depth, but nothing there plausibly matches.
